mermaid:
flowchart TB
    CO["Company account"] --> LOC1["Location Groningen shop"]
    CO --> LOC2["Location Assen shop"]
    CO --> CT1["Contact owner, approver"]
    CO --> CT2["Contact buyer, orders only"]
    CO --> PL["Price agreement and assortment"]
    CO --> TERMS["Payment terms net 30 and credit limit"]
    LOC1 --> ORD["Order placed for a location"]
    CT2 --> ORD
    PL --> ORD
    TERMS -->|"credit check"| ORD

sequenceDiagram
    participant B as Buyer at the shop
    participant P as B2B portal
    participant PR as Pricing source
    participant ERP as ERP receivables
    participant OMS as Order record
    B->>P: Add 60 jackets and 120 pairs of socks
    P->>PR: Prices for this company, today
    PR-->>P: Contract prices, effective dates
    B->>P: Place order on net 30 terms
    P->>ERP: Credit check, order value against open balance
    ERP-->>P: Over limit by 1,184 euro, hold for approval
    P->>OMS: Create order, status awaiting seller approval
    OMS-->>B: Order received, pending approval
    ERP-->>OMS: Approved by Head of Wholesale
    OMS->>OMS: Release to fulfillment
